run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the largest subsequence with GCD greater than 1
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple input arrays and expected outputs
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that counts elements divisible by each candidate divisor

refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to optimize the nested loop approach for finding largest GCD subsequence
